discovery_checkpoint.evidence_digest: Use STARTUPINFOEX with PROC_THREAD_ATTRIBUTE_HANDLE_LIST for only target stdio; terminate and bounded-wait the held suspended target on every post-CreateProcess pre-assignment failure; make attach timeout/invalid frame synchronously fail the handle, close stdin, terminate the exact helper, and await bounded helper exit; make readiness poll identity-bound target custody rather than helper exitCode. Add structural/fault-injection and bounded native proofs without raw-PID target authority.

JOB-AC-1.evidence: The embedded helper probes CreateJobObjectW and kill-on-close configuration before advertising supported capability.

JOB-AC-2.evidence: CreateProcessW uses CREATE_SUSPENDED and an explicit stdio handle allow-list; the Job is configured, assigned, creation time is captured from the held process handle, and only then is ResumeThread called.

JOB-AC-3.evidence: Opaque helper/Job custody is checked against PID and creation time, all termination commands operate through the Job handle, target-handle waits bound convergence, and EOF/helper loss/release close the Job with bounded helper cleanup.

JOB-AC-4.evidence: Windows capability reports windows_validated_tree unavailable when the Job probe fails, PID reattachment is refused, and the raw taskkill path cannot establish supported custody; Linux remains on its separate process-group adapter.

JOB-AC-5.evidence: The owned focused suite/build and bounded disposable Windows native proof were reported passing; release/docs assertions cover portability, lifecycle, identity, failure modes, and support boundaries.
